name: Azusa Yumiko
source:
She is the Principal of the High School and she helps the students find their families they lost.

Very friendly, she always offers a coffee, a fruit juice, a tea or milk to drink with little cakes to the people she receives in her office.

A very pretty woman that [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]the protagonist[/url] would have approached if he was a little more older.
